RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias. Healthcare and laboratory professions have high female representation, so an all-female panel frequently occurs naturally based on organizational roles. 

Department head positions prioritize administrative competency and people management over academic research credentials. The appointed candidate possessed formal management training and broad leadership experience, which directly align with director-level requirements. 

Raising gender without documented discriminatory remarks or procedural breaches will likely harm your professional reputation and prospects within the hospital. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, framing it constructively around how you can expand your management qualifications and leadership scope for future executive roles.
